title: Sequence Reconstruction
description: Each sequence contains labels from 1 through `n`. Return true if `nums` is the only possible shortest common supersequence of all sequences, meaning the directed ordering constraints determine every adjacent pair in `nums` uniquely. Otherwise return false.
constraints: Each sequence value is in [1, nums.length]
hints: Represent prerequisites as directed edges and process zero in-degree vertices.
A cycle prevents a complete ordering; unique orderings require a single available choice at each step.
